walkthroughs.body_html:
Acid: donates H+ (pH < 7).

Alkali: dissolves to give OH-.

Neutralisation: H+ + OH- -> H2O.

HCl + NaOH -> NaCl + H2O.

H2SO4 -> sulfate; HNO3 -> nitrate.

Balance equations: same atoms each side.

Mass before = mass after, including any gas.
